messages.content: Hello! I am your Product Manager for BioVault Lab. I have reviewed the discovery log from our Business Analyst. We are solving the core pain: Yes, let's begin. We are building BioVault Lab to eliminate sample misplacement and compliance penalties in clinical diagnostic labs.... I have prepared the complete, grounded Product Requirement Document (PRD) adhering strictly to the handbook standard. You can review the full PRD and the stage-by-stage token and cost estimates below.

scores.evidence: Found 4 unique features. Must-have FR coverage: 4/4.
Found 8 unique ACs with 12 Given/When/Then clauses across 4 features. Vague terms present: False.
Detected 4 explicit (unhappy path) criteria across 4 features.
Non-goals table (NG-###) present with rationale and source citations.
Success metrics with numeric targets and telemetry/query measurement methods present.
Clean separation of FRs and NFRs.

scores.fix: Remove invented roles, placeholders, tech choices, and redundant sentences

scores.evidence: Timeline and budget cited with scope trade-off reasoning.

unsupported_claims.text: Today (Q-001) and Core problem (Q-001) cite the same source
unsupported_claims.reason: Section 2 defect: 'Today' and 'Core problem' must come from different client answers
